findings.summary: Criterion 2b is now discriminative and bound to the engine-effective limit (NODE_TIMEOUT_HALF_MS is derived from workflows/deep-research/tick/workflow.yaml limits.node_timeout, the seed board carries proposed clues with triageThreshold=1 so decideTick really emits a triage decision, board reads/publishes go over a real loopback HTTP server, and AGENT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS=16000 sits above the 15000 ms bound so reverting the §1.2 short-circuit or the §1.1 catch turns it red). Residual gap: it still calls runChannelWrite() in-process instead of spawning the real tick-entry `--run` CLI (the pattern test/e0c2-termination.test.ts uses with test/fixtures/fake-bus.mjs), so process/dependency startup — one of the latency phases §1.1b enumerates — stays outside the measured window. Non-blocking: the argv→runChannelWrite→JSON layer is separately covered by g4b R1.

The GT-16 seed board uses three proposed clues rather than the single-clue seed board §2 criterion 2b names, and because the triage read short-circuits the tick ends before any CAS/harvest, so timings.runWriteMs covers only spawn plus the worker-result wait. The two GT-16 cases also share one beforeAll HTTP server and republish the same entity ids, so GT-16b measures a six-message board. None of this weakens the bound assertion, but a single-clue board driven end-to-end would match the criterion literally.

When a triage run exits without a dr-triage.result.v1 the recorded report sets runId to the empty string; the run identity survives only inside skippedReason's message text. Consumers keying on TriageReport.runId cannot attribute the local failure to its run without parsing prose. Carrying the run id in the field as well would keep the diagnostic structured.

Previously flagged items are all resolved this round and were verified against the product files: --max-clues is merged into the tickConfig handed to decideTermination so MAX_CLUES=24 genuinely narrows capHit (src/tick-run.ts:1601 with the profile declaration at profiles/deploy/e0-regression.env:60 and the deep-research-loop.sh → fleet.yaml.tpl → workflow.yaml → tick.md → --max-clues chain); GT-17a now drives the production assembleGenerateDeps readBody instead of a hand-copied re-implementation; the Y5 reverse case constructs a genuine non-matching journal (外部调用成功) and asserts exit 0; and the busReadMs assertion is relaxed to >= 0. §1.3 still reuses scripts/check-drain-failures.mjs, which names both run_dir and status for [外部调用失败 status=<S>].
